grammarFocus: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of。
title: A Class Debate on School Start Times
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力练习，适合B1–B2水平学习者。请先听录音（或阅读录音文本），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误（True/False/Not Given）。填空答案必须来自录音原文，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文。
transcript:
Mia: Hi everyone, thanks for coming to the student council meeting. Today we need to plan our class debate. The topic is: should school start later in the morning? I think we should start with clear topic sentences.

Leo: Good idea. So, each speaker needs a topic sentence that states their main point. Then they support it with reasons and examples. For example, a topic sentence could be: 'Starting school later improves students' health.' Then the speaker gives evidence, like research about sleep.

Mia: Right. Although some students like early starts, many feel tired in first period. While the school says early starts prepare us for work, students say they can't concentrate. Because of this, we want to debate the issue.

Leo: Also, we need to use 'because' and 'because of' correctly. 'Because' is followed by a clause, like 'because students need more sleep.' 'Because of' is followed by a noun phrase, like 'because of the early start.'

Mia: Exactly. And we should also use 'although' and 'while' to show contrast. For instance: 'Although the school day is long, students can still do sports after school.' Or 'While some teachers prefer early starts, others don't.'

Leo: Let's also think about the structure of our arguments. Each paragraph should have a topic sentence, supporting sentences, and a concluding sentence. The topic sentence is like a signpost. It tells the listener what the paragraph is about.

Mia: Yes. And we must avoid going off-topic. So, when we prepare our speeches, we should check that every supporting sentence connects to the topic sentence.

Leo: Another thing: we need to anticipate counterarguments. For example, if we argue for later starts, we should also mention the opposing view and refute it. That makes our argument stronger.

Mia: Good point. So, in the debate, we'll have two teams: one for later starts, one against. Each team will present their arguments using topic sentences and supporting sentences. Then we'll have a discussion.

Leo: And remember, the debate is next Friday at 3 p.m. in the school hall. We need to prepare our speeches by Wednesday.

Mia: OK, let's get started. Thanks, everyone.

grammar.title: 主题句与支持句；although / while；because 与 because of
grammar.explanation: 在段落中，主题句（topic sentence）陈述主要观点，支持句（supporting sentences）提供理由或例子。'although'和'while'用于表示对比，后面接从句。'because'后接从句，表示原因；'because of'后接名词短语，表示原因。
grammar.example: Although the school day is long, students can still do sports after school. Because of the early start, students feel tired.

options: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
Although it was raining, so we went for a walk.
Although it was raining because we went for a walk.
Although it was raining, we went for a walk because.
answers: Although it was raining, we went for a walk.
questions.explanation: 'although'引导让步状语从句，主句前不加'so'或'because'。
questions.evidence: Although the school day is long, students can still do sports after school.

options: While some teachers prefer early starts, others don't.
While some teachers prefer early starts, so others don't.
While some teachers prefer early starts because others don't.
While some teachers prefer early starts, others don't because.
answers: While some teachers prefer early starts, others don't.
questions.explanation: 'while'表示对比，连接两个分句，不需要'so'或'because'。
questions.evidence: While some teachers prefer early starts, others don't.

options: Because students need more sleep, they should start school later.
Because of students need more sleep, they should start school later.
Because students need more sleep, so they should start school later.
Because students need more sleep, they should start school later because.
answers: Because students need more sleep, they should start school later.
questions.evidence: 'Because' is followed by a clause, like 'because students need more sleep.'

options: Because of the early start, students feel tired.
Because the early start, students feel tired.
Because of the early start, so students feel tired.
Because of the early start, students feel tired because.
answers: Because of the early start, students feel tired.
questions.explanation: 'because of'后接名词短语，主句前不加'so'。
questions.evidence: 'Because of' is followed by a noun phrase, like 'because of the early start.'
